title: Inter-dimensional trafficking/recruiters dream
content: After finding this page and the learning many of us seem to have the same odd dreams. I’m curious if anyone else has experienced this one as well. It gives me just the worst sinking feeling thinking about it still but it felt so real and I couldn’t leave the dream no matter how much I woke my self up that night I went right back in it. And they were pissed I kept leaving. Anyways in my dream there’s a man late 40s shoulder length hair very calm and persuasive personality to him but over exaggerated smile and he has an assistant but she or he doesn’t have clear details it’s like they’re blocked in my memory but basically they approach people offering job applications in busy settings to try sign on people for “This job “ The main setting is like a huge white slope with like stations to either side and each station are portals to different realms or something like that. And the very last one at the bottom to the right side is the portal to home and it’s essentially some sort of trafficking situation and you’re stuck having to go to where you’re ordered to go for specific reasons through each portal station. But you can not go back home or else you’re done for. They seem to have to have you sign your soul over to them before they can take you there which is why they offer jobs to young people in a coffee shop or at the mall . This place was so familiar so was this man in my dream I had went back to it to try find and get my sister out who had just unknowingly signed herself over to them and I knew what it really was but wasn’t allowed to tell her like for I would have been killed and unable to return to our world for warning her in the moment. Anyways being as this dream felt so unnaturally real and I still haven’t shaken the feeling form it nearly a year later I wonder if anyone else has been here too Hope that made sense
